items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yashir Zady, I studied with him for several years.

ctx.x: This is in the 70s. This is 30 years later.

That’s right. The lessons never stopped. I took lessons from this guy, Joe Postacoff in the Village for a time. But, Yashir Zady, I studied with him for several years. He knew all of the concert repertoire. He’s jazz player, this is classics. But, you see, you have to work on things like—I found that working on classics helped me to play jazz. The techniques involved when playing classical have to help you when you’re playing jazz. They help your facility. I think it improves you thinking, you know? It influences…
What schools did you go to?
